description:
What composes the remnant church? Is it only Seventh-day Adventists?

Subscribe | Like | Share

#thewordinspired #denishamccurchin #randyskeete #randyskeetelive #randyskeeteq_a #randyskeete2021 #presenttruth #revelation12
